content: Corrosion (superfly) is Rust, not Go: workspace with crates/ (corro-agent with agent/{mod,bootstrap,handlers,reaper,run_root,setup,tests}, broadcast/, plumtree/, transport.rs; plum-foca SWIM membership; tripwire shutdown-signal crate; spawn supervision; corro-devcluster with topology shaper) plus integration-tests/ running real CLI processes. Precedents: dedicated shutdown-signal component, reaper task for peer GC, devcluster topology shaper; no public DST harness.
